metadata.vcsCommitMessage:
feat(infra): add Ansible operational automation + update Bastion IAM policies

Ansible Automation (infrastructure/ansible/):
- Add 7 playbooks: setup, migrations, seed, health-check, maintenance, backup, disaster-recovery
- Add reusable task files for single-db operations (migrate, seed, backup, restore)
- Add bastion-setup role: Node.js 20, Prisma CLI, AWS CLI v2, S3 bucket creation
- Add ansible-vault encrypted secrets for database credentials
- Add 6 wrapper scripts for quick execution (run-migrations.sh, etc.)
- Add inventory with bastion host and group_vars configuration
- Add comprehensive README with architecture, usage examples and vault setup

Terraform Bastion Module (infrastructure/terraform/modules/bastion/):
- Add IAM policy for S3 backup bucket (put, get, delete, list, create, versioning, lifecycle)
- Add IAM policy for Secrets Manager read access (GetSecretValue, DescribeSecret)
- Add aws_region variable for Secrets Manager ARN scoping
- Increase root volume from 8GB to 30GB (Amazon Linux 2023 AMI requirement)
- Add AnsibleRole tag for inventory identification

Production Environment (infrastructure/terraform/environments/production/):
- Pass aws_region to bastion module for IAM policy configuration

Other:
- Update .gitignore with Ansible vault password and secrets exclusions
- Create S3 bucket fastmeals-db-backups with versioning and 7-day lifecycle
- Fix bastion-to-RDS security group rule after SG recreation

Tested: health-check passing — RDS (5 DBs) ✅, Redis ✅, API GW ✅, Bastion ✅
